prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for every Dallas roof replacement — the best choice depends on your exact location in Dallas, the roof type and size, your budget and timeline, and which warranties and service you value most. I can help you pick the best contractor for your situation if you tell me your ZIP code, whether it’s a residential or commercial job, and what roof material you want.

If you want to start now, here’s a practical way to find the best company and what to check for:

What to look for (must-haves)
- Valid Texas contractor license and local city requirements (Dallas may require permits; the contractor should handle them).  
- Current general liability and worker’s compensation insurance (ask for certificates).  
- Manufacturer certification (GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning, etc.) if you want extended manufacturer-backed warranties.  
- Strong recent customer reviews (Google, Yelp) and a good rating with the BBB.  
- Local references and examples of recent Dallas jobs.  
- Clear written estimate detailing scope (tear-off vs. overlay), materials, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, disposal fees, and timeline.  
- Written warranties for materials and workmanship (get length and whether it is transferrable).  
- Clean-up plan and confirmation they will pull required permits/inspections.

Red flags
- High-pressure sales tactics, “storm-chaser” claims or insisting on cash-only deals.  
- No physical office or evasive about providing proof of insurance/license.  
- Very low bid far below other estimates — usually a sign of shortcuts or low-quality materials.  
- Refusal to provide a written contract or timeline.

How to choose
- Get at least three written bids that show comparable scopes (so you’re comparing apples-to-apples).  
- Compare materials, workmanship warranty length, and the contractor’s responsiveness more than price alone.  
- Ask each company for a reference from a Dallas homeowner they worked for within the last year. Call those references.  
- Verify insurance and licensing yourself (ask for the insurer’s phone number and license number).

Questions to ask a roofer
- Are you licensed in Texas and registered with the City of Dallas?  
- Can you provide proof of general liability and workers’ comp insurance?  
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle/metal manufacturer I want?  
- What exactly is included in this bid (ventilation, flashing, ice/water shield, number of layers removed)?  
- What is your expected start date and completion timeline?  
- What warranties are provided and are any transferable?  
- How will you protect landscaping and clean up nails and debris?

Ballpark cost & timeline (Dallas, residential, rough ranges)
- Costs vary widely by roof size, pitch, material, and condition. For a typical single-family home replacing asphalt shingles expect a multi-thousand-dollar range; small-to-medium jobs often run from several thousand to low tens of thousands of dollars. A realistic next step is to get estimates from local contractors for a precise number and timeline. (If you want, I can give more detailed ballpark numbers if you tell me home size and roof material.)

If you want, I can:
- Find and shortlist top-rated Dallas roofers near your ZIP code (I’ll need your ZIP), or  
- Draft an email or script you can use to request bids and check references, or  
- Walk you through comparing three bids you’ve already received.

Which would you like to do next? Provide your ZIP code and whether the job is residential or commercial and the roof material you’re considering.
